versions.changelog:
- Initial release of xueqiu-skill, providing an API tool for querying Xueqiu investment data.
- Supports searching users, portfolios, and posts on Xueqiu by keyword.
- Allows retrieving ranked portfolios, real-time portfolio quotes, and net value history.
- Enables access to detailed portfolio info, user-created portfolio lists, user posts, and rebalancing history.
- Includes usage limits, authentication, error handling, and detailed API documentation for integration.
